writer_and_runner_audit.exact_raw_binary: PASS_STATIC_AND_CPU_REFERENCE: the GPU predicate is exact numeric equality to 0 or 1 before uint8 conversion; nonbinary reference attacks fail and no threshold/nonzero coercion is present.
writer_and_runner_audit.packing: PASS_FOR_FROZEN_SHAPES: contiguous logical flatten plus numpy packbits little is C-order/little-bit; all 310 frozen calls are byte aligned, and independent odd-tail CPU tests confirm high-bit zero behavior.
writer_and_runner_audit.atomic_call_files: PASS: exclusive partial creation, size/count checks, hard-link no-replace publication, and partial cleanup are covered by producer and independent collision/failure tests.
writer_and_runner_audit.call_population: PASS_FAIL_CLOSED_AT_RUNTIME: unique module target order plus end_sample makes a missing, duplicate, repeated, or reordered target hook fail; all 31 modules must fire once in each sample before close.
writer_and_runner_audit.sample_and_shape_identity: PASS: dataset identity construction matches the frozen profiler, shuffle is disabled, batch and workers are frozen, and hook input/output shapes are compared to the per-sample plan.
writer_and_runner_audit.parameter_identity: PASS_STATIC: target module type and weight element count are checked; runtime manifests contain little-endian C-order weight/bias shape, dtype, byte count, and content SHA256 computed after exact checkpoint load.
writer_and_runner_audit.checkpoint_identity: PASS_STATIC: checkpoint basename, size, and SHA256 and config SHA256 are checked before model construction; load audit requires zero missing/unexpected keys.
writer_and_runner_audit.hook_lifecycle: PASS_FOR_PYTHON_EXCEPTIONS: registered handles are removed in finally and writer aborts to FAILED.json for Exception-derived errors.

findings.finding: The runner has no explicit CUDA synchronization after model(x), before end_sample, or before writer.close publishes a PASS manifest.
findings.evidence: The frozen runner contains no torch.cuda.synchronize call. Chunk .item() and GPU-to-CPU transfers synchronize captured inputs, but kernels after the final target hook can remain asynchronous.
findings.impact: A deferred CUDA execution error in trailing work of the final sample can surface after a PASS manifest is published, violating fail-closed run completion.
findings.required_repair: Synchronize the active CUDA device immediately after every model(x) and again before close; any synchronization error must flow through writer.abort before manifest publication. Add a GPU/mock test that injects a deferred failure.

findings.finding: stream_torch_binary calls tensor.detach().contiguous().view(-1) before chunking, so a non-contiguous hook input can allocate a full-call GPU copy.
findings.evidence: The largest frozen call is 147,456,000 elements, or 589,824,000 bytes (562.5 MiB) at float32, in addition to the configured 8,388,608-element chunk workspaces.
findings.impact: The implementation does not prove the contract's bounded-chunk memory claim and can create an avoidable full-tensor peak or OOM before streaming.
findings.required_repair: Either require input.is_contiguous() and fail closed before capture, with a frozen GPU proof that all 310 hooks satisfy it, or implement true C-order chunk extraction without a full contiguous materialization. Record peak allocated/reserved CUDA memory in the runtime manifest.

findings.finding: The six producer CPU tests exercise the pure writer but do not execute the actual torch/numpy GPU stream_torch_binary function.
findings.impact: GPU dtype conversion, CUDA chunk boundaries, synchronization behavior, and numpy packbits integration are static-only before remote execution.
findings.recommended_followup: Add CPU-torch tests plus CUDA tests for float32/bool inputs, nonbinary/NaN/Inf values, multiple chunks, non-contiguous inputs, and injected transfer failure.

findings.finding: The plan carries temporal steps 0..9 but does not explicitly encode temporal_axis=0 or the per-step slice shape.
findings.impact: The independent reconstruction confirms every frozen input has leading dimension 10, but downstream offline delta derivation otherwise relies on an implicit layout convention.
findings.recommended_followup: Add temporal_axis=0, temporal_steps=10, and per_temporal_step_shape/elements to every call and validate them against the execution trace.

findings.finding: The failure handler catches Exception but not KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit, SIGTERM, or process/node loss.
findings.impact: Such interruption can leave an output root and finalized call files without FAILED.json. Absence of manifest and overwrite refusal remain fail closed, but failure provenance is incomplete.
findings.recommended_followup: Use a launcher-level non-overwriting run receipt/trap and atomic status file so interrupted runs are explicitly marked incomplete.

findings.finding: The preflight does not check output filesystem free space for the exact 1,313,280,000-byte payload plus manifests and safety margin.
findings.impact: Insufficient disk fails safely mid-run but wastes GPU time and leaves a partial failed root.
findings.recommended_followup: Require and record statvfs free bytes before model construction with an explicit safety margin.

findings.finding: The producer preflight receipt records source hashes but is not itself sealed with command/stdout/stderr/return-code evidence.
findings.impact: The receipt is reproducible and independently anchored here, but its original invocation is less auditable than the exact-SHA Synopsys milestones.
findings.recommended_followup: Emit a non-overwriting preflight run directory with input/output manifests, return codes, logs, and a completion seal.

admitted_claims: The frozen CSVs independently reconstruct a consistent 31-module target plan comprising 7 Conv2d and 24 Linear modules, 10 samples, 310 calls, and 3100 exact dual-line rows.
The frozen plan accounts for exactly 10,506,240,000 binary input elements and 1,313,280,000 packed bytes; all frozen calls are byte aligned and have leading temporal dimension 10.
The pure-CPU writer and preflight identities are reproducible and fail closed for the tested shape/order/nonbinary/collision/partial-write and manifest attacks.
not_admitted: M51-r1 as GPU-ready until both P1 runner repairs are implemented and independently retested.
Any activation payload has been captured or validated.
Any output tensor, cycle, latency, throughput, speedup, utilization, traffic, energy, PPA, RTL, VCS, DC, STA, Formality, SRAM/DRAM, full-system, competitor, DATE, or best-paper claim.
decision: The frozen target derivation and pure-CPU writer boundary are sound, but the GPU runner is NO-GO as a GPU-ready launch artifact until explicit CUDA completion synchronization and genuinely bounded memory behavior are repaired. This review admits static/CPU preflight evidence only and no captured or performance result.
